title: GazeSample
description: One webcam gaze estimate, on the same clock as Blindspot's TelemetryEvent (ms since case shown).

x.description: image px; absent when off-image, on UI, or invalid

y.description: image px; absent when off-image, on UI, or invalid

sigma.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in IMAGE px = session screen-px accuracy / view.scale (or / (loupe_mag*scale) on the loupe)

vp.description: visible image rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] in image px

on_loupe.description: true when mapped through the loupe transform

target.description: what was under the gaze point

face_lum.description: mean face-region luminance 0-255 at capture, when measured

slice.description: reserved for CT/MRI stacks; unused for radiographs
